chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Leipzig, 2024. Champions League: RB Leipzig against Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz gets the ball out wide. He spins away from one defender, cuts past another, and another... then curls it in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Small, quick touches keep the ball close to his feet, so he can change direction the moment a defender comes.

chapters.label: Far corner
chapters.text: His left-footed shot bends around Gulácsi, into the far corner. Real Madrid win one-nil.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball close with small touches. Then you can change direction past each defender.
